clock: time_s = (original host timestamp - first explicit START sent_host_ms)/1000; no fitted shift
limits: Radio times are result receipt, commands use ACK receipt, TX uses completed-event receipt, camera uses frame-read completion.
These host timestamps are not synchronized optical/device event times and do not establish latency.
Camera mean is mean over 23 fixed CAL masks, each mean RGB minus its own pre-start baseline; no photometry.
Remembered p/valid are separate from lifecycle; stopping/stopped do not revive on RF success.
